description: The Chinese Academy of Sciences Earth System Model version 2.1 Climate System Model (CAS-ESM2-1-CSM) is a coupled climate system configuration of the CAS-ESM family, developed at the Institute of Atmospheric Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences. It builds on the CAS-ESM2 framework developed and applied for CMIP6, with a coupled representation of the atmosphere, land surface, ocean, sea ice, atmospheric chemistry, and aerosols. CAS-ESM2-1-CSM dynamically simulates six component domains. The atmospheric component is IAP-AGCM5.0, the land-surface component is CoLM2014, the ocean component is LICOM2.0, and the sea-ice component is CICE4.0. Atmospheric chemistry is represented by CAM5-Trop-MAM3, while aerosols are represented by CAM5-MAM3. These components form a coupled modelling system for simulating the physical climate system and its interactions with atmospheric composition and aerosols across a wide range of temporal and spatial scales. No scientific component domain is classified as a prescribed component in this configuration. Ocean biogeochemistry and land ice are omitted. CAS-ESM2-1-CSM is therefore designed primarily for coupled climate-system simulations, including studies of climate mean state, variability, historical climate change, climate sensitivity, and future climate change and projection, while retaining interactive representations of atmospheric chemistry and aerosols.
